Title: Serverless offer for Azure Cosmos DB in preview on all APIs

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB serverless is in preview for all Azure Cosmos DB APIs, including Core (SQL), MongoDB, Cassandra, Gremlin, and Table. This offers NoSQL developers a database operations option with zero capacity planning or management required. As a consumption-based option with no minimum, serverless could also significantly lower the entry price for applications. It is ideally suited for small and medium-sized workloads that do not require steady throughput, receive requests sporadically or in short bursts, and have moderate performance requirements.

Learn more about Azure Cosmos DB serverless.
